title: Ales From The Crypt – Halloween Hang
description: Why let the kids have all the fun? Join us in the taproom on Friday, October 31st for Ales From The Crypt – Halloween Hang! We’ll have DJ Coffee Lady spinning chill house beats, a costume contest, and of course, plenty of beer and treats.
